claims.claim: Thatcher effect 1980 published
claims.support_or_limit: Thompson's 1980 report in Perception 9(4):483–484
claims.editorial_action: cite as original historical report, original photos rights restricted

claims.claim: Local eye/mouth inversion more obvious when whole face upright
claims.support_or_limit: Task/stimulus/orientation dependent; avoid universal language

claims.claim: Thatcher effect proves humans see nothing upside down
claims.support_or_limit: Overstated interpretation

claims.claim: Thatcher effect unique to face processing
claims.support_or_limit: 2010 tests found related effects with non-face objects

claims.claim: 2010 non-face replication categories
claims.support_or_limit: Cars, buildings, bicycles, letter strings; face exclusivity not supported by authors

claims.claim: 2014 fMRI superior temporal sulcus orientation dependence
claims.support_or_limit: fMRI adaptation study, not whole-brain causal proof

claims.claim: Body orientation may matter to inversion effect
claims.support_or_limit: 2007 human-turntable orientation study; do not imply singular definitive mechanism

claims.claim: Historical magnetism files include record of failures/consent issues
claims.support_or_limit: Public Puységur archive documents failures, consent conflict and witness limitations

claims.claim: Zen12 produced effects seen in Thatcher experiments
claims.support_or_limit: No product-specific trial in examined perceptual papers
